name: The Lighthouse of Salt Harbour
atmosphere: Left in a hurry, not in a fight: nothing is knocked over, but everything is left where it stood.
body:
## On first entering

> [!readaloud] Inside it smells of cold lamp oil and salt. The
> spiral stair vanishes into the dark above you, and on the table
> sits a half-eaten meal, untouched for days.

## Who is here

- nobody, and that is exactly the problem
